test_title: SSC CHSL Tier-1 2022: Official Paper (Held On: 21 March, 2023 Shift 3)
subject: general
question: Select the most appropriate option to fill in blank number 5.
solution:
The correct answer is** 'Option 3' **i.e.** 'one another'.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **In this context,** the spheres are forming layers on top of other spheres, meaning they are interacting with each other.
 
• **'One another' **is used when each member of a group is doing something to the others, which fits the context here.

Therefore, the **correct sentence** is: *'Rock candy is actually a collection of large sugar crystals that are "grown" from a sugar-water solution. Crystals form when the smallest particles of a substance, the molecules, arrange themselves in a/an orderly and repetitive pattern. Molecules are too small for us to see moving around and arranging themselves, but you can get a rough idea of what this would look like by taking a small shallow tray and filling it with marbles, ball bearings, or other spheres. As you add more spheres, the bottom of the tray becomes covered, then the spheres must form layers on top of **one another,** and a structure or pattern emerges.'*

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• Let's consider the other options:
 
 
• **'Others': **This choice could technically work, but it is less precise than 'one another' because it does not necessarily imply that every sphere is interacting with all the others.
 
• **'One': **This option is incorrect because it would mean that all the spheres are forming layers on top of a single sphere, which doesn't make sense in this context.
 
• **'Every other': **This option is also incorrect because it implies that only every second sphere is involved in the layering, which does not fit the context.
